name: get_addon_status
description: Check Blender, add-on, and protocol versions, capabilities, and runtime state, including runtime.sketchfab. Call first. If up_to_date is false, follow update_command.

name: get_blender_api_info
description: Inspect installed Blender RNA metadata before writing Python: a type's properties and functions (kind=TYPE, e.g. Camera) or an operator's parameters (kind=OPERATOR, e.g. mesh.primitive_cube_add). Reports defaults, ranges, enum items, and operator poll. Enum items are static, so context-dependent choices are missing. Node types (e.g. ShaderNodeMix) omit members common to all nodes and add a temporary node's sockets, menu items, and the settings that enable or use each socket. Does not read instance values or run operators.

identifier.description: bpy.types name or operator ID, without the bpy prefix.

query.description: Case-insensitive member or socket name substring.

name: get_scene_info
description: Inspect the active scene (mode, selection, camera, units) and a page of objects sorted by name, 20 by default. Filters combine with AND. Restart at offset 0 after adding, removing, or renaming objects.

object_type.description: Uppercase type, e.g. MESH, CAMERA, or LIGHT.

name: get_object_info
description: Inspect an object by exact name: local transform (rotation follows rotation_mode), matrix_world, dimensions, parent, collections, modifiers, visibility, materials, and base mesh counts and bounds. Cameras add lens, field of view, sensor, clipping, and depth of field.

evaluated.description: Add mesh counts after modifiers, instance sources, and bounds including instances at the current frame. Slow on dense geometry.

details.description: Add summaries of the first 20 material slots and modifiers, and animation.

name: get_material_info
description: Inspect a material: settings, shader nodes sorted by name (20 per page by default), stored socket defaults, incoming links, images, and animation overview. Nested node groups are references; use get_node_group_info. For animation use get_animation_info with MATERIAL or MATERIAL_NODES.

name: get_node_group_info
description: Inspect a shader or geometry node group: interface, nodes sorted by name, settings, sockets, incoming links, and animation overview. Nested groups are references. Modifier input overrides are in get_modifier_info.

name: get_modifier_info
description: Inspect one modifier: stack index, viewport and render flags, settings, and data-block references. Geometry Nodes adds its node group and input overrides. Reports stored values; use get_object_info(evaluated=true) for the resulting geometry.

name: get_animation_info
description: Inspect animation without changing the frame or evaluating drivers: the assigned action and slot, then pages of channels, drivers, and NLA tracks and strips. Channel ranges are action-local frames; strip ranges are scene frames. Excludes constraints and simulation caches.

data_name.description: Owner name. OBJECT_DATA and SHAPE_KEYS take the object name; MATERIAL_NODES, WORLD_NODES, and COMPOSITOR_NODES take the material, world, or scene name.

name: set_camera
description: Change a camera's projection, lens, sensor, depth of field, panorama, ortho scale, shift, or clipping, and optionally make it the scene camera. Lengths are millimetres. object_names fits evaluated bounds while keeping the camera's orientation (PERSP or ORTHO; mute camera constraints first). Changes shared camera data.

focus_object.description: Object name, or empty to clear.

name: set_viewport
description: Inspect or change a single-view 3D viewport; omit settings to inspect. Sets view, projection, shading, overlays, gizmos, and zoom, or frames ALL, SELECTED, or named objects. Framing keeps selection, exits camera view, and excludes distance. Axis views default to orthographic. camera_zoom only changes the CAMERA view display; use set_camera for the lens.

name: get_viewport_screenshot
description: Capture a single-view 3D viewport as an image. This is a preview, not a render; frame and shade with set_viewport first. camera_only=true captures the active camera's frame (PERSP or ORTHO) without changing the view.

name: execute_blender_code
description: Run Python on Blender's main thread with bpy imported. Prefer bpy.data; bpy.ops can need mode, selection, or context overrides. Print results; stdout and stderr each keep 16,384 characters. Errors are not rolled back: check started, succeeded, and partial_changes (null means effects outside inspection are possible). A timeout does not stop execution, so inspect before retrying. Each started run adds one undo step. checkpoint or summarize_changes adds an execution_id for get_execution_result.

code.description: Use print() to return values. May be empty when resetting a namespace.

namespace.description: Unique task ID. Its globals persist until reset, file load, undo/redo, or server restart. Blender data and modules are shared.

reset_namespace.description: Clear the namespace first. Send empty code to release it.

checkpoint.description: Save a checkpoint first; requires Object mode. Code does not run if saving fails.

summarize_changes.description: Report created, changed, and removed objects, first 100 each. Covers object and data properties, modifiers, constraints, materials, and base meshes; not shaders, animation, or scene settings. Requires Object mode and scans all objects.

name: checkpoints
description: Manage up to 32 .blend checkpoints that persist across restarts. create saves the open file without changing its path; list returns IDs, labels, and times; delete removes one permanently. restore saves a safety checkpoint, opens a working copy of the checkpoint, and clears all namespaces; it does not undo external effects, render jobs, or callbacks. create and restore require Object mode. Linked files, caches, and Python state are not saved.

name: get_execution_result
description: Retrieve an execute_blender_code result that used checkpoint or summarize_changes, including after a timeout; waits for running Python. Omit execution_id for the latest, which may belong to another client, so check namespace and code_sha256. Keeps eight results until the add-on stops.

name: get_execution_changes
description: Page through one category of object changes from an execute_blender_code call with summarize_changes=true.

name: start_render
description: Render one still frame from a scene snapshot in a separate Blender process, leaving the open scene unchanged. Returns job_id; poll get_render_status, then use get_render_image or export_render. One job runs at a time. Save or pack edited images first. A client timeout does not cancel the job; check get_render_status before retrying.

name: start_animation_render
description: Render a PNG sequence (no video or audio) from a scene snapshot in a separate Blender process. Frame settings default to the scene's; at most 10000 frames. Writes output_directory/frames/frame_0000001.png and so on. Poll get_render_status. Output survives cancellation and restarts; continue with resume_animation_render. One job runs at a time. Save or pack edited images first; keep external assets and caches unchanged.

output_directory.description: New absolute directory on the Blender machine with an existing parent.

name: resume_animation_render
description: Resume an animation render after cancellation, failure, or restart. Renders only missing or changed frames from the original snapshot; later scene edits are excluded.

name: get_render_status
description: Get a render job's state (running, cancelling, completed, cancelled, or failed), phase, frame, progress, and error_message. Sample progress covers only the current sampling stage. Animation jobs add frame counts, fps, and estimates. Omit job_id for the latest job. Handles expire on server stop or after eight newer jobs.

name: cancel_render
description: Request cancellation of a render job; poll get_render_status until cancelled. Completed animation frames are kept.

name: get_render_image
description: Return a render as a PNG scaled to max_size. Animation frames are available while running and after cancellation or failure.

frame.description: Default: latest completed frame. Stills must match.

name: export_render
description: Save a render as a full-resolution PNG on the Blender machine. Returns filepath, dimensions, size_bytes, and sha256.

filepath.description: Absolute .png path with an existing parent.

frame.description: Default: latest completed frame. Stills must match.

name: get_sketchfab_status
description: Check whether Sketchfab is enabled and has an API key.

name: search_sketchfab_models
description: Search Sketchfab models.

name: get_sketchfab_model_preview
description: Get a Sketchfab model's thumbnail to check it before downloading.

name: download_sketchfab_model
description: Download and import a Sketchfab model, scaled so its largest dimension equals target_size. Returns object names, dimensions, and bounds. Credit the author as its license requires.
